text:
I understand the timing is tight. Unfortunately, **shipped orders can't have their shipping address changed**, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy.

Your best option is to contact the courier directly once you have the tracking number—they may be able to redirect it to your new address, though this isn't guaranteed. You can find the tracking number in your order confirmation email or under "My Orders" on the website/app.

If the courier can't help, the parcel will arrive at your original address and you may need to arrange collection or redelivery from there. Would you like me to escalate this to a Support Lead to explore other options?
